closing_note: Closed without collecting. The freeze was opened to protect a seven-day window that was never started: no pilot host was available, and a window measures the host it runs on. Reopen it at the then-current head when a host exists -- an open freeze protecting nothing trains everyone to ignore a red build.
head: 0042_stream_outer_joins
reason: Seven-day availability, RPO, and RTO collection. A migration during this window voids it and costs another seven days.
